## Locations
- [Punta Mita](https://casitahomes.com/locations/punta-mita): Punta Mita is a private peninsula on Mexico&#x27;s Pacific Coast, about 45 minutes north of Puerto Vallarta in the state of Nayarit. Framed by the Sierra Madre mountains and the warm waters of Banderas Bay — one of the largest bays in the world — it&#x27;s home to some of Mexico&#x27;s most coveted real estate, world-class surf breaks, and two Jack Nicklaus-designed golf courses. The area draws a well-traveled crowd looking for a quieter, more refined alternative to the busier resort corridor to the south, with a strong lineup of luxury hotels, private villa communities, and excellent dining.
- [Mazunte](https://casitahomes.com/locations/mazunte): Mazunte is a tiny, laid-back village on Oaxaca&#x27;s Pacific coast, known for its wild, largely undeveloped beaches and strong counterculture / eco-conscious vibe. It draws travelers who want the opposite of a resort scene - think palapa guesthouses, cliff-top yoga shalas, and mezcal at sunset. Playa Mazunte and Playa San Agustinillo are the main draws, with calm bays ideal for swimming and bodyboarding. The area sits close to Punta Cometa, one of Mexico&#x27;s southernmost points and arguably the best sunset lookout on the coast.
- [New Properties](https://casitahomes.com/locations/new-properties):
- [Costa Rica (Early Access)](https://casitahomes.com/locations/costa-rica): Early Access Costa Rica Collection
- [Sayulita, San Pancho &amp; Vallarta](https://casitahomes.com/locations/saylita-san-pancho-vallarta): A stunning 200-mile stretch of pacific coastline in Mexico that includes Puerto Vallarta, Sayulita, San Pancho, and so much more
- [San Miguel &amp; Guanajuato](https://casitahomes.com/locations/san-miguel-de-allende): An architect&#x27;s dreamscape, where centuries-old charm collides with avant-garde brilliance, San Miguel de Allende is an urban symphony of timeless design.
- [Tepoztlán &amp; Morelos](https://casitahomes.com/locations/tepoztlan): In Tepoztlán, homes effortlessly fuse ancient mystique with avant-garde vibes, creating a laid-back yet vibrant architectural tapestry just 90 minutes from CDMX.
- [Merida &amp; Yucatan](https://casitahomes.com/locations/merida): Merida, where colonial charm meets bohemian grit. Dive into the city&#x27;s eclectic vibe, fueled by homes that blend historic elegance with artistic rebellion.
- [More Locations](https://casitahomes.com/locations/more-locations): Incredible designer homes that don&#x27;t yet fit into specific collections.
- [Mexico City](https://casitahomes.com/locations/mexico-city): Mexico City, a place where history, grit and grace coalesce. Homes echo the city&#x27;s resilience, intertwining modernity with the enduring spirit of its vibrant streets.
- [Baja California Sur](https://casitahomes.com/locations/baja-california-sur): In Baja California Sur, homes embody coastal ease, seamlessly weaving traditional charm into the modern landscape—a serene architectural embrace by the sea.
- [Valle de Guadalupe &amp; Ensenada](https://casitahomes.com/locations/valle-de-guadalupe): Set on Mexico&#x27;s Baja California coast only 90 minutes from San Diego, Valle de Guadalupe is one of the world&#x27;s fastest growing wine regions — with designer homes dotting rolling hillsides.
- [Tulum &amp; Riviera Maya](https://casitahomes.com/locations/riviera-maya-tulum): A bohemian-chic haven on Mexico&#x27;s Caribbean coast — the Riviera Maya stretches from Cancun all the way down past Tulum and is one of the most sought-after destinations for boutique homes.
- [Puerto Escondido](https://casitahomes.com/locations/puerto-escondido): Puerto Escondido is a bohemian beach town on the Pacific Coast of Oaxaca. In recent years, it has become a popular destination for Mexico&#x27;s most lauded architects to build designer homes.
- [Oaxaca](https://casitahomes.com/locations/oaxaca): In Oaxaca, homes seamlessly embody colonial charm and modern design, creating architectural gems that weave effortlessly into the vibrant surroundings.
- [Careyes](https://casitahomes.com/locations/careyes): In Careyes, coastal opulence unfolds as homes seamlessly blend traditional charm with contemporary grandeur, crafting architectural masterpieces by the serene sea.
- [Ixtapa-Zihuatanejo](https://casitahomes.com/locations/zihuatanejo): In Ixtapa-Zihuatanejo, coastal elegance unfolds as homes seamlessly merge traditional charm with modern allure, crafting architectural marvels that embrace the tranquil surroundings.
